caption: Five words from FP + 12 down to FP - 4. The callee writes the control link first; the return sequence reads it to restore the caller's FP, and the final jump reads the return address last.

spec.title: One activation record, 4-byte words
spec.aria: An activation record with parameter b at FP + 12 at the top, then parameter a, the return address, the saved old FP at FP + 0, and local x at FP - 4 at the bottom.
